iterations.strategy: Category B — algorithm change to eliminate cache-exceeding data structure. Root cause: orders_custkey pre-build (240MB vector, 5.5x LLC) dominated runtime at ~200ms (134ms allocation/init page faults + 71ms data_loading fill). Fix: eliminate orders_custkey entirely; during lineitem scan, use direct two-step lookup ord_lookup[l_orderkey] -> row_id -> o_custkey[row_id]. Since lineitem is sorted by l_orderkey, both ord_lookup and o_custkey accesses are sequential — apply MADV_SEQUENTIAL. With zonemap filtering (29% selectivity), only ~87MB additional bandwidth during parallel scan vs 540MB serial in data_loading. Kept supp_nation_flag (~100KB, L2-resident) and cust_nation_flag (~1.5MB, LLC-resident) as they are small and provide O(1) filtering. All mmap resources declared before RAII timer scope to exclude TLB shootdown. Expected: ~25-35ms total.
